name: Special Event Volunteer (age 14 and up)
what_you_do: Volunteers help run zoo special events like Easter Eggstravaganza, Boo at the Zoo and Zoobilee. You can sign up for all events or only the ones that fit your schedule.
who_can_apply: Age 14 or older for special events. For some events, volunteers under 18 must come with an adult. Husbandry aide volunteers must be 18.
duration: Event by event, spread through the year
deadline_text: The zoo says it will begin taking new volunteer applications in April 2027. Orientations also start again in April 2027.
how_to_apply: Applications start again in April 2027. Then use the Get Started link on the volunteer page to contact the zoo, complete a volunteer application, and go to a volunteer orientation (2nd Saturday 8 to 10 a.m. or 4th Thursday 4 to 6 p.m. at the Cargill Learning Center).
notes: Quote from the page: Must be 14 years of age to volunteer for Special Events. Groups can do service days in the zoo departments from age 16, scheduled two weeks ahead, April through October. Adults 18 and over must pass a background check.
